text:
olivia_csm: Need a 1-page "pocket card" for go-live priming + renewal-risk signals focused on caching/batching/streaming. customers prefer a checklist.
kevin_eng: I can draft a concise checklist + 2 config snippets. keep ops notes minimal.
jess_cs: One-liner for customers please: what we do and why.
olivia_csm: One-liner: 'We'll run a short priming job to warm model instances and cache common prefixes so your initial users see low latency.'
kevin_eng: Suggested customer checklist (copy-paste):
1) Preflight: confirm model pin & service account perms.
2) Approve 30min priming window.
3) Run priming: prefill ~20 flows, warm_pool=2.
4) Post-check: run 5 golden prompts, report latency & any odd outputs.
sam_sre: Quick runtime knobs to share: batch.max_requests=6 (lower for low-traffic), cache_ttl=600s, streaming=true for UX but expect more connections. Fallback: streaming=false or route to smaller model.
kevin_eng: Minimal config snippet customers can hand to infra: 
`priming: {enabled:true, prefill:20, warm_pool:2} serving: {batch:{max_requests:6}, streaming:true, cache_ttl:600}`
jess_cs: Post-priming email template: Subject: "Priming finished 4AA" Body bullets: 1) Outputs OK? (Y/N) 2) Avg latency (ms) 3) Any errors/timeouts.
sam_sre: Renewal-risk thresholds for ops to monitor: errors >3x baseline for 10m, golden success rate drop >=30% over 1h, avg latency >=2x baseline for 15m -> escalate to #eng-oncall. Add automation: alert -> create ticket tag onboarding:high-risk.
olivia_csm: Great. i'll turn this into a one-pager and paste into customer emails. tagging @kevin_eng @sam_sre for final tech review. ETA tomorrow AM.
opsbot: Created internal priming job template at /ops/templates/priming-pocketcard.yaml :white_check_mark:
